scope: Offline A/B planning; no transport, physical playback or acoustic/thermal measurement. Two presets, same inventory/configuration, including the existing shared HDD eight-hit experiment.
sourceIdentityAudit: Lost important source IDs rechecked against same-part octave-equivalent tones at original NOTE_ON; not an acoustic measurement.

methodology.identity: SHA256 of full MIDI bytes; copies count once, different encodings can represent the same composition
methodology.important: source events classified lead/bass; bass can include upper tones of a polyphonic track
methodology.originalOnset: any tonal ExecutionTimeline command for the source ID within 1 microsecond of source NOTE_ON; this is stricter than allowed musical microdelay
methodology.lengthCoverage: intersection with source gate including CONTINUATION extras; intentional short FDD articulation can lower this measure
methodology.primaryVsCopies: FDD source attacks exclude reinforcement copies; optional accents are checked separately
methodology.equivalentTone: Same source track/channel, same source pitch class and exact original onset (1 microsecond). Octave equivalents are only partial musical representation, not proof of identical played octave, acoustic timbre or duration.
methodology.lowestSourceTone: Lowest source MIDI pitch in the same track/channel within 15 ms of the source onset; a heuristic, not a verified bass fundamental.
methodology.planningSeconds: Wall-clock time per variant including arrangement and metric calculation under concurrent offline workers; not application upload latency or isolated arranger performance.
